personal.name: Hernan Leon

personal.headline: Twenty years of large-scale data platforms and the teams that build them, in Colombia, China, Mexico and Germany.
personal.summary: For twenty years I have taken large, multi-country programmes and got them live: the kind with a dozen stakeholders, three time zones and a regulator waiting at the end. A 200-million-record warehouse built to satisfy IFRS9, the European banking regulation, for Volkswagen Financial Services in China and Mexico, with twenty people across five offices. A CRM platform for BMW China carried through a doubling of its retail network. Today a customer-intelligence product running across a 50-location retail network in Germany, where I own the product, its architecture, the rollout, and the AWS estate underneath.

home.displayTitle: Twenty years of large-scale data platforms, built in four countries.
home.places: Bogotá, then Beijing and Shanghai, then Puebla at a distance, now Munich.
home.lede: For twenty years I have taken large, multi-country programmes and got them live: the kind with a dozen stakeholders, three time zones and a regulator waiting at the end.
paragraphs: A 200-million-record warehouse built to satisfy IFRS9, the European banking regulation, for Volkswagen Financial Services in China and Mexico, with twenty people across five offices. A CRM platform for BMW China carried through a doubling of its retail network. Today a customer-intelligence product running across a 50-location retail network in Germany, where I own the product, its architecture, the rollout, and the AWS estate underneath.

The industry has been automotive and the finance arms attached to it. The problems have not been: regulated data at scale, a distributed retail network, and a product several thousand people open every morning.

The last ten months have been the same work with more reach. AI agents now carry the load that used to need a team around me, which is how one person covers product, architecture, implementation and infrastructure without giving up any of the scope.

timeline.note: The thin band is Mexico. I led the Volkswagen Financial Services warehouse build in Puebla for five years without leaving China, which is where I learned to run a team across time zones.

capabilities.name: Leading international teams
capabilities.body: Twenty people across Beijing, Shanghai, Munich, Casablanca and Puebla, on one programme, in three time zones. I built the handover method that turned the time difference into an advantage instead of a tax. I have led as a developer among the team and as the person accountable for the whole delivery, in four countries and three languages.

capabilities.name: Product ownership
capabilities.body: I decide what the products do next and carry them to the businesses that run on them: a retail network of 50 locations. Recently a retail-system integration for BMW North America, lead scoring that reads a buyer's budget, authority, need and timing, and a configuration report customers can read without me in the room.

capabilities.name: System architecture
capabilities.body: A 200-million-record warehouse for Volkswagen Financial Services in China and Mexico, designed to satisfy IFRS9 across ten business areas and sixty business objects. Today: three AWS accounts, a Kubernetes cluster per environment, ArgoCD deploying from a GitOps repository whose secrets are sealed with KMS, all of it written as Terraform.

capabilities.name: Implementation and rollout
capabilities.body: Getting it live is the job, and it is the part most programmes fail at. A CRM platform for BMW China through a doubling of its retail network to 400 partners and 500 users. BMW North America through staging into production. New customers imported, enriched and handed over.

capabilities.name: Infrastructure
capabilities.body: The platform stays up because someone reads the alarms. I found and fixed the firewall rules quietly returning errors on legitimate file uploads, put the API documentation behind constant-time credential checks, and built the tooling that pulls a production log off any server without opening an SSH port.

capabilities.name: Working with AI agents
capabilities.body: The last ten months have been the same work with more reach. Agents carry what used to need a team around me, 229 commits across ten codebases, while I keep the architecture and the judgement calls. It is leverage on twenty years of pattern recognition, not a substitute for it.
